hero.title: Connect your AI agent to El Portal.
hero.description: The El Portal MCP server exposes your personal operating system to any MCP-compatible AI client. Read your cycle state, log habits, and run daily check-ins without leaving your agent workflow.

capabilities.heading: Capabilities
capabilities.intro: Read tools are granted on all keys by default. Write tools require explicit opt-in at key creation time.

step1.heading: 1. Generate an API key
step1.body: Go to Settings > API Keys in El Portal. Your key is shown once on creation. Copy it immediately. Keys start with ep_ followed by 64 hex characters. SHA-256 hashed before storage, never recoverable after creation. Up to 10 active keys per account, with optional expiry up to 365 days.

step2.heading: 2. Choose a transport
step2.body: Use <stdioTag>stdio</stdioTag> for local AI tools (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Continue). Use <httpTag>HTTP</httpTag> for web-based agents or custom server-side integrations.

toolReference.heading: Tool reference
toolReference.intro: All tools use JSON-RPC 2.0 via the MCP protocol. Expand each entry for parameter shapes and return values.

read.label: read
read.body: Granted on all keys by default. No extra configuration required.

write.label: write
write.body: Opt-in per key. Toggle individual write tools during key creation or in key settings.

storage.label: storage
storage.body: Keys are SHA-256 hashed before storage. Plaintext is never stored and cannot be recovered after creation.

cta.heading: Ready to connect?
cta.body: Generate your first API key in Settings and drop it into your MCP config. Full read access in under a minute.

read.portal_snapshot: Full dashboard state. Active cycle, habits with streaks and done_today, goals, daily score. Optional sections: pulse_today, archives, identity, mantras.
read.portal_review: Cycle review data. Daily scores, habit consistency percentages, days remaining.
read.portal_history: Browse past versions, cycles, or debriefs. Filter by version or status.
read.portal_search: Full-text search across goals, habits, archives, and mantras. Up to 50 results.

write.portal_log_habits: Log habits done or undone for any date. Upsert-safe. Batch up to 30. Returns updated streaks and daily score.
write.portal_pulse: Read or write morning/evening pulse check-ins. Covers mood, energy, sleep, stress, performance, feelings, and reflection.
write.portal_create_cycle: Create a complete cycle in one call: goals, habits, priorities, mantras, and carry-over goals from previous cycles.
write.portal_debrief_cycle: Close a cycle. Server computes stats (average score, top habits, goal completion rate). You provide the reflection.
write.portal_create: Create new entities: version, goal, habit, archive, mantra, or identity item. Batch up to 10.
write.portal_update: Partial update any entity type. Batch up to 10 operations.
write.portal_delete: Delete entities by ID. Cascades where applicable. Batch up to 10.
write.portal_settings: Read or update your user profile and app preferences.
